earliestTime.description: Specifies the earliest time in the time range to search.

latestTime.description: Specifies the latest time in the time range to search.

searchQuery.description: Search query to execute on the splunk server. The field names returned by the search should align with the field names in the target SplunkSearchResultRow type for automated population

count.description: A number that indicates the maximum number of entities to return. Max Limit is 50000.  Defaults to 100.

splunkServer.description: Splunk server to execute the query upon. E.g "prod-splunk.c3-e.com", "dev-splunk.c3-e.com".

searchType.description: The type of data being searched. See SplunkSearchType. Defaults to "Action"

name.description: A friendly name for this search. E.g. "Top actions by count", "Most expensive actions by host"

title: A specialization of SplunkSearchSpec, adding fields relevant to storage (name, type)
name: SplunkSavedSearchSpec
